title: libpcap capture file signature (microsecond timestamps)
summary: A classic libpcap capture file begins with the magic number 0xA1B2C3D4 (stored little-endian as D4 C3 B2 A1) for microsecond-resolution timestamps.
source_version: Wikipedia List of file signatures, retrieved 2026-05-29

notes: Bytes 4-5: major version (2). Bytes 6-7: minor version (4).
Bytes 8-11: thiszone (GMT offset). Bytes 12-15: sigfigs. Bytes 16-19: snaplen. Bytes 20-23: network (link-layer type).
Big-endian file uses the byte-swapped magic A1 B2 C3 D4.
